message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The case: burglary/attempted theft. The defendant broke into a residence, attempted theft but didn't obtain property. That's "盗窃未遂" (theft attempt). In Chinese criminal law, the crime is theft (盗窃罪). The description says "已着手实施犯罪，因意志以外的原因而未得逞，系犯罪未遂，依法可比照既遂犯从轻处罚". So the charge is theft (盗窃). Possibly also "入室盗窃" but the label used in examples: they use "盗窃". For example earlier: "盗窃;非法狩猎" for a case of stealing trees. So answer: 盗窃.

Thus output: [罪名]盗窃<eoa>
